title: Replication and consistency
prompt: Async primary-replica. Product requires read-your-writes after profile edit. Candidate says “replicas are fine for everything.” Fix?

choices.label: Sticky read-after-write to primary or version token until caught up
choices.consequence: Async lag otherwise shows stale self-views.

choices.label: Keep all reads on replicas always
choices.consequence: Users see their own old profile.

choices.label: Synchronously replicate to 20 regions on every keystroke
